description: Pembrolizumab is recommended as an option for untreated metastatic colorectal cancer with high microsatellite instability (MSI) or mismatch repair (MMR) deficiency in adults, only if pembrolizumab is stopped after 2 years and no documented disease progression, and the company provides pembrolizumab according to the commercial arrangement.
